messages:
emma-billing: Heads-up — customer ACME (acct: C-9982) reported a mismatch between their dashboard usage and the final invoice INV-2026-03-01. They see a €0.01 overcharge on the invoice compared to the dashboard.

emma-billing: Quick invoice snippet they pasted:```
INV-2026-03-01
1) model: redwood-standard tokens 1,234.56 -> $12.34
2) FX USD->EUR @0.89 -> €10.9756 -> displayed €10.98
3) other rounding adjustments -> total billed: €10.99
```

emma-billing: Dashboard shows €10.98. Customer insists the invoice rounded each line differently than the dashboard aggregation. Ticket: CS-98765.

josh-support: Thanks — adding here. Can you attach the raw meter export (per-request lines) and the invoice PDF? cc @marta-finance @kai-eng :mag:

emma-billing: Uploaded meter export to the ticket and attached the PDF. export file: `acme-C-9982-meter-2026-03-01.csv` (S3 link).

marta-finance: I can repro on a small sample. Root cause is almost always per-request rounding + currency conversion performed per-line, then summed and rounded again for presentation. We should aggregate in the smallest currency unit (microcents) before rounding to avoid these 0.01 discrepancies.

kai-eng: Repro steps I ran against internal meter API:```bash
# get per-request cost in USD (raw decimal)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://metering.internal/api/v1/usage?account=C-9982&date=2026-03-01" > usage.json
# sample line from usage.json
# { "request_id": "r1", "model": "redwood-standard", "tokens": 1234.56, "cost_usd": 0.9756 }
```

kai-eng: Example math that causes the gap:
- three requests each cost $0.3333 (raw) -> raw sum = $0.9999
- if you round each to 2dp: $0.33 + $0.33 + $0.33 = $0.99 (dashboard might show aggregated raw then round)
- if you convert per-line USD->EUR @0.89 and round per-line then sum you can get +/− €0.01 relative to converting the aggregated USD total

kai-eng: Short-term repro I did: summed per-line rounded EUR -> €10.99, summed raw USD then converted+rounded -> €10.98. So both behaviours exist depending on pipeline order.

marta-finance: Proposed fix:
1) Change billing pipeline to store and aggregate costs as integer microcents (USD * 1e6) or smallest supported unit, do currency conversion on aggregated raw cents, then round for display.
2) Update invoice formatting to show pre-rounded subtotal and a clearly labeled "display rounding" line when applicable.

josh-support: For the customer: suggest immediate credit of €0.01 for goodwill and note the reconciliation. Do we have approval to issue one-off credit?

marta-finance: Approve one-off credit of €0.01 for CS-98765. I'll create a credit memo and note root cause in finance ticket FIN-4482.

kai-eng: I'll open an engineering ticket ENG-2145 to change aggregation to integer micros and add a small regression test that compares per-line vs aggregated flows. Target patch for next week deploy.

invoice-bot: Invoice regen complete (high-precision totals): INV-2026-03-01-v2 attached to ticket. Visual diff: removed per-line rounding, final total now €10.98.

emma-billing: Customer updated — accepted €0.01 credit and wants confirmation when change is in prod. They asked for a short explainers they can keep.

josh-support: Drafting explainer: "We discovered the invoice generation pipeline performed currency conversion and rounded each line individually. This caused a one-cent discrepancy vs your dashboard which aggregates raw usage before conversion. We’ve issued a €0.01 credit and are updating our billing pipeline to aggregate in the smallest currency unit before rounding to prevent recurrence." I'll paste in ticket and CC the customer.

marta-finance: Also logging for tax/VAT calcs: ensure VAT applied after final rounded total per local regulations. ENG-2145 should include a test matrix for VAT calculation order (pre/post rounding).

kai-eng: Noted. Will add VAT order tests and a corner-case test: mixed-currency charges on same invoice.

josh-support: Thanks all — tagging this resolved for now pending ENG-2145 deployment. :white_check_mark:

emma-billing: marking ticket CS-98765 as pending customer confirmation after credit is applied.\n
